description: This is the main WSGI entry point for the Number Plate Recognition Flask application. It sets up the application for deployment in WSGI servers, exposes the Flask app as 'application', and contains a main block for local testing that outputs route information.

methods.name: __main__
methods.description: Main block for local testing, prints route information and runs the Flask app with debugging and threading enabled.

ctags.name: application
ctags.pattern: /^from app import app as application  # Expose as `application` for WSGI servers$/
